name: Dr. K. Dinesh
title: Faculty
bio: Dr. K. Dinesh is a faculty member in the Department of Management Studies at National Institute of Technology Warangal (NIT Warangal). His research interests span strategic innovation, system dynamics, flexible systems management, and entrepreneurship. He has published in leading SSCI/Scopus-indexed journals and has been involved in significant research projects funded by national and international agencies.
